# Milestone 6 (part): interval coverage for the shrinkage estimator (generated by run.py)

227 groups in 73 families; group x budget rows per n&#772;: 50: 227, 100: 225, 200: 216, 400: 167. Coverage is exact under the normal approximation, given each group's transferred-model bias; nominal 95%.

## Check of the approximation

- analytic RMSE of FH_prior against the simulated one (300 draws, m6_allocation): median |relative difference| 3.9%, 87.2% of rows within 10%, 90th percentile 11.2%; by n&#772;: 50: 93.0%, 100: 91.1%, 200: 84.7%, 400: 77.2%
- diagnostic (not pre-registered): with the finite-population factor 1 &minus; n/N that the simulation's draws without replacement carry, median 3.4%, 94.7% within 10%, 90th percentile 8.4%. Coverage below uses no such factor, since a real subgroup is not a finite list of asked rows.

## Prediction checks (LOG.md, 2026-11-14)

1. analytic RMSE within 10% of simulated in at least 90% of rows: 87.2%
2. FH_naive mean coverage 85 to 92% at 50: 93.8%; at least 25% of groups below 80%: 6.2%
3. FH_robust mean coverage at least 93% at every n&#772;: 96.8%, 95.1%, 94.1%, 95.0%; at most 10% below 80% at 50: 3.1%; median half-width 0.70 to 0.95 of D's at 50: 0.832
4. FH_cmse mean coverage within 2 points of 95%: 89.1%, 92.1%, 93.9%, 94.5%; median width above 0.95 of D's: 0.698, 0.805, 0.888, 0.927
5. period lowest FH_naive coverage of the kinds at 50: generation 94.1%, period 90.6%, tradition 94.8%
Refutation (FH_robust mean coverage below 90% at 50): 96.8%
